button.doc: A button in the harness style. Use kind "primary" for the one main action of a view and "danger" for deleting.

props.name: kind
props.doc: Look of the button. Default is "default".

props.name: size
props.doc: "sm" for a small button inside rows and cards.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Greys it out and ignores presses.

badge.doc: A small coloured label for a status or a count.

card.doc: A bordered box with an optional title, body, footer and buttons in the header. Use it to group one thing, such as a timer or a note.

props.name: subtitle
props.doc: One quiet line under the heading.

props.name: footer
props.doc: Content at the bottom, such as buttons.

props.name: actions
props.doc: Buttons shown on the right of the heading.

section.doc: A heading with content under it and no box. Use it to split a panel into parts.

props.name: actions
props.doc: Buttons on the right of the heading.

row.doc: One line of a list: an optional check mark, a title, a quiet second line and something on the right. Rows are the unit lists and listApp are made of.

props.name: right
props.doc: Text or a badge at the right end.

props.name: mark
props.doc: Adds a check box; onchange gets true or false.

list.doc: A stack of rows, or a message when there are none.

props.name: empty
props.doc: Text shown when items is empty.

table.doc: A table with a header row. Cells show row[key], or the result of render(row) when a column has one.

props.name: columns
props.doc: One per column; align is "right" for numbers.

props.name: empty
props.doc: Text shown when there are no rows.

props.name: onRowClick
props.doc: Called with the row when it is clicked.

tabs.doc: A row of tabs that switches the content below it.

props.name: tabs
props.doc: content is a string, Node or Array.

props.name: active
props.doc: Id of the tab shown first. Default is the first one.

props.name: onChange
props.doc: Called with the id when the user switches.

field.doc: A labelled input. Give a type (text, number, date, textarea, select, checkbox) or your own input element. Read the value from the returned element's control.

props.name: help
props.doc: A quiet line under the input.

props.name: input
props.doc: Your own input element instead of type.

form.doc: A set of fields with a submit button. onSubmit gets an object with one value per field name (numbers as numbers, check boxes as true or false).

props.name: submit
props.doc: Text of the submit button. Default is "Save".

props.name: onSubmit
props.doc: Called with (values, formElement). May be async; the button is disabled while it runs.

kv.doc: Labels with their values, for details such as a record's properties.

stat.doc: One big number with a label, for dashboards. Put several in a row with a flex container, or inside a card.

props.name: hint
props.doc: A quiet line under it, such as a change.

empty.doc: A centred message for a view with nothing in it, with an optional button that fixes that.

props.name: action
props.doc: A button, for example {label: "Add one", onclick}.

example.title: No timers yet
example.text: Start one to see it here.

modal.doc: A dialog over the panel. It returns the overlay element: append it to el. It closes on Esc, on a click outside, or with the element's close() method.

props.name: actions
props.doc: Buttons at the bottom. A button with kind "primary" is the main one.

chart.doc: A simple bar or line chart of labelled numbers.

props.name: unit
props.doc: Text added after each value, such as "min".
